title: Design: A/P Detail links use the native report link style
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has a long name (more than 40 characters) and open documents at both locations on today's date, including a vendor credit (its Transaction Type is the longest).
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-13 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment and Trailer Repair.
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every group expanded (Expand all).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the document numbers that are links.
  2. Press Tab until a link has keyboard focus.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: they use the native report link style: the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline.
  • Step 2: the focused link is underlined; links are underlined only on keyboard focus.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-open-balance-pinned-light.png: figure "Open Balance pinned, light" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-opens-by-vendor-name.png: figure "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name" (This build (after)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting"

The design's own words:

  • "The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is bold and pinned right; the group label stays at the left. S8-R3, S8-R4, S4-R7." (caption of "Open Balance pinned, light")
  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05): the PRD says "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. This case follows the PRD; the difference is question 15 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is held in D-80.
